title: Decoding Transformer Dynamics via Koopman Subspaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.29113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We apply Koopman operator theory and Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to characterise how large language models (LLMs) process different input topics. Treating the layer-to-layer evolution of hidden states as a dynamical system, we fit a linear Koopman operator and take the subspace spanned by its dominant modes as a per-topic spectral fingerprint. Four findings emerge. First, the depth map is near-linear: a single linear operator predicts each next-layer state to within approx. 18% relative error (interior variance explained approx. 0.99). Second, over the 57 MMLU subjects the fingerprint is topic-discriminative, matching the MMLU taxonomy at 0.72 nearest-neighbour purity and each subject's semantic neighbourhood at 0.75 any-hit@3. Third, it is a reproducible signature (split-half self-retrieval approx. 0.97$). translated_title: 通过Koopman子空间解码Transformer动力学
translated_abstract: 我们应用Koopman算子理论和动态模态分解（DMD）来刻画大型语言模型（LLMs）如何处理不同的输入主题。我们将隐藏状态的逐层演化视为一个动力系统，拟合一个线性Koopman算子，并将其主导模态张成的子空间作为每个主题的谱指纹。研究得出四项发现：第一，深度映射接近线性——单个线性算子即可预测每个下一层状态，相对误差约为18%（内部方差解释率约为0.99）；第二，在MMLU的57个学科上，该指纹具有主题判别性，与MMLU分类体系的最近邻纯度匹配度为0.72，与各学科语义邻域的any-hit@3达到0.75；第三，它是一种可复现的签名（折半自检索约为0.97）；最后，这些发现在七个基础模型（Qwen2.5 0.5B-7B、Llama-3 1B-8B）上保持一致，并呈现出一个具有提示意义的趋势（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文将Transformer隐藏状态的逐层演化建模为动力系统，利用Koopman算子理论提取主导模态子空间作为主题“谱指纹”，证明模型深度映射近似线性、指纹可判别不同学科主题且在多个模型间可复现。
en_tdlr: This paper models the layer-to-layer evolution of hidden states in Transformers as a dynamical system, applying Koopman operator theory to extract dominant-mode subspaces as per-topic "spectral fingerprints," demonstrating that the depth map is near-linear, topic-discriminative, and reproducible across multiple base models.
